Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Rollback**: checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. I rolled it back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production. The rollback completed in all regions.

2. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 with the error rate down to 0.2%.

3. **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) titled "checkout-api unhealthy following v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", which describes the health-check failures, the rollback, and notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation. The on-call engineer has been paged.
